findings.title: Numeric discrete labels passed to hue= are colored as continuous values on a CYCLIC hls palette -- extreme labels get identical colors; shipped plot_clusters2 gallery figure is effectively monochrome
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
np.random.seed(0)
c1 = np.random.multivariate_normal(np.zeros(3), np.eye(3), size=100)
c2 = np.random.multivariate_normal(np.zeros(3)+3, np.eye(3), size=100)
data = np.vstack([c1, c2])
labels = hyp.cluster(data, n_clusters=2)
fig = hyp.plot(data, '.', hue=labels, show=False)
cols = {tuple(np.round(np.asarray(c)[:3],3)) for coll in fig.axes[0].collections for c in coll.get_facecolor()}
print(cols)  # {(0.86,0.34,0.34),(0.86,0.371,0.34)} -- visually identical reds
findings.expected: Two clearly distinct colors for the two clusters (hls(2) = red (0.86,0.371,0.34) and cyan (0.34,0.829,0.86), as produced when the same labels are passed as strings), and a legend available for discrete labels.
findings.actual: distinct point colors in hue=cluster_labels plot: 2 [(0.86, 0.34, 0.34), (0.86, 0.371, 0.34)]  |  k=3 int hue: [(0.34,0.829,0.86),(0.86,0.34,0.34),(0.86,0.371,0.34)] (clusters 0 and 2 both red)  |  hls(100)[0]=(0.86,0.3712,0.34), hls(100)[99]=(0.86,0.34,0.34)  |  WARN UserWarning: legend is not supported for continuous or matrix-valued hue; ignoring legend.

findings.title: plot_autoencoders gallery figure: VariationalAutoencoder panel is a degenerate collapsed embedding (deterministically, every docs build)
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
t = np.linspace(0, 3*np.pi, 300)
manifold = np.column_stack([t*np.cos(t), t*np.sin(t)])
data = manifold @ rng.standard_normal((2,10)) + 0.05*rng.standard_normal((300,10))
kw = {'epochs':30,'batch_size':32,'random_state':0}
v = np.asarray(hyp.reduce(data, reduce={'model':'VariationalAutoencoder','kwargs':kw}, ndims=2))
print(np.ptp(v[:,0]), np.ptp(v[:,1]))  # ~0.0343 0.0669
findings.expected: A VAE panel showing the manifold unfolded (or at least structured), with span comparable to the data scale, supporting the example's pedagogical claim.
findings.actual: VAE deterministic across runs: True; VAE span x: 0.0343 y: 0.0669; PCA span x: 47.9 y: 26.3; VAE dim-vs-t |spearman|: 0.225, 0.388 (panel renders as a collapsed line with mixed colors)

findings.title: plot_mixture_models.py 'equivalently' claim: the two figures use permuted component colors because GaussianMixture is refit unseeded
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
data = np.vstack([rng.standard_normal((100,5)) + 1.5*i for i in range(3)])
p1 = np.asarray(hyp.cluster(data, cluster='GaussianMixture', n_clusters=3))
p2 = np.asarray(hyp.cluster(data, cluster='GaussianMixture', n_clusters=3))
print(np.array_equal(p1.argmax(1), p2.argmax(1)))  # False
findings.expected: The two plots render with identical color-to-component assignment, matching the prose 'equivalently, pass any (n_samples, k) matrix as hue'.
findings.actual: same argmax component ids across two identical calls: False; argmax head p1: [1 1 1 1 1] p2: [2 2 2 2 2]; fig1 colors left-to-right red/blue/green, fig2 green/blue/red

findings.title: hyp.reduce silently returns the input unchanged when ndims >= n_features, even for explicitly requested nonlinear embeddings (TSNE)
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
data = np.random.default_rng(0).standard_normal((30,5))
out = np.asarray(hyp.reduce(data, reduce='TSNE', ndims=50))
print(out.shape, np.allclose(out, data))  # (30, 5) True -- silent passthrough
findings.expected: Either an error (sklearn TSNE itself rejects n_components>3 with barnes_hut) or a loud warning that reduction was skipped because ndims >= n_features.
findings.actual: TSNE ndims=50 -> (30, 5); passthrough (allclose to input): True; no warning captured

findings.title: Autoencoder reducers silently accept invalid training hyperparameters (epochs=-5 returns an untrained embedding)
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
data = np.random.default_rng(0).standard_normal((30,5))
out = hyp.reduce(data, reduce={'model':'Autoencoder','kwargs':{'epochs':-5}}, ndims=2)

findings.expected: ValueError: epochs must be a positive integer (got -5).
findings.actual: NO ERROR; AE epochs=-5 -> (30, 2) finite: True

findings.title: describe(): show=True default calls plt.show() (UserWarning headless); show=False leaves NO way to get the figure; figure has 4 same-color unlabeled curves
findings.repro:
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, hypertools as hyp
res = hyp.describe(hyp.load('weights_sample'), show=False)
print(sorted(res.keys()), plt.get_fignums())  # ['average','individual'] []
findings.expected: describe(show=False) returns or retains the figure (e.g. a 'fig' entry in the dict); curves distinguished by color/legend (individual vs average); no forced plt.show() side effect in library code.
findings.actual: describe returns: dict ['average', 'individual']; figs open after describe(show=False): []; runner warning: '=== WARN UserWarning: FigureCanvasAgg is non-interactive, and thus cannot be shown'; saved figure shows overlapping same-color unlabeled curves
